item.rejuvcrests.blank_crest.desc: An empty crest. Craft it with gems and a signature item to make a crest for a specific Pokémon.
item.rejuvcrests.gothitelle_crest.desc: Using Dark- and Psychic-type moves swaps between respective types. Recovers HP. SpATK buffed by 1.25x.
item.rejuvcrests.magcargo_crest.desc: Magcargo's Defense and Speed are swapped, and Sp. Atk increases by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.fearow_crest.desc: Increases the power of stabbing moves by 50%. Increase critical-hit ratio by 1.
item.rejuvcrests.stantler_crest.desc: Increases Stantler's and Wyrdeer's Attack and Accuracy by 50%.
item.rejuvcrests.hypno_crest.desc: Increases Hypno's Special Attack and Accuracy by 50%.
item.rejuvcrests.glaceon_crest.desc: Glaceon takes resisted damage from Rock and Fighting attacks. Abilities apply regardless of the weather.
item.rejuvcrests.leafeon_crest.desc: Leafeon takes resisted damage from Fire and Flying attacks. Abilities apply regardless of if their weather is active.
item.rejuvcrests.relicanth_crest.desc: Increases Relicanth's Attack by 25% and Sp. Def by 35%.
item.rejuvcrests.oricorio_crest.desc: Increases Oricorio's Speed and Sp. Atk stat by 25%.
item.rejuvcrests.silvally_crest.desc: Has a special effect for each held Memory. Attack and SpAtk. increase by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.seviper_crest.desc: Seviper deals more damage against healthier foes, up to 50%. Speed increased by 50%.
item.rejuvcrests.cofagrigus_crest.desc: Increases Cofagrigus's Defense by 40% and Sp. Atk by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.dusknoir_crest.desc: Increases Dusknoir's Attack by 50% and boosts weaker moves.
item.rejuvcrests.skuntank_crest.desc: Nullifies damage and boosts Attack when hit by a Ground-type move. Increases Attack and Sp. Atk by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.darmanitan_crest.desc: Darmanitan is forced into Zen Mode while holding this crest.
item.rejuvcrests.cherrim_crest.desc: Activates Flower Gift regardless of weather. Flower Gift additionally boosts Defense and SpAtk.
item.rejuvcrests.claydol_crest.desc: Claydol's Special attacks use its Defense stat. The power of beam moves is increased by 50%.
item.rejuvcrests.dedenne_crest.desc: Dedenne's Physical attacks use its Speed stat rather than Attack stat.
item.rejuvcrests.zangoose_crest.desc: Zangoose becomes poisoned upon switching in, and restores HP while poisoned.
item.rejuvcrests.bastiodon_crest.desc: Attackers take 50% of the damage they deal as recoil, and the wearer is healed the same amount.
item.rejuvcrests.meganium_crest.desc: Meganium and its allies take reduced damage and recover every turn.
item.rejuvcrests.typhlosion_crest.desc: Typhlosion's Attack is equivalent with Sp. Atk, and contact moves do an additional hit of damage.
item.rejuvcrests.feraligatr_crest.desc: First move has increased priority if it's damaging. Biting moves deal 50% more damage.
item.rejuvcrests.rampardos_crest.desc: Rampardos will hang on with 1HP regardless of HP once per battle and does not take recoil.
item.rejuvcrests.ledian_crest.desc: Ledian punches four times at once. Secondary effects only occur on the first two hits.
item.rejuvcrests.ariados_crest.desc: Ariados's speed is increased by 50% and cannot be lowered. Deals critical hits against slowed or poisoned targets.
item.rejuvcrests.spiritomb_crest.desc: Spiritomb becomes stronger for each defeated ally. Recovers health based on KO'd enemies.
item.rejuvcrests.whiscash_crest.desc: Nullifies damage and boosts Attack when hit by a Grass-type move. Increase Atk and Sp. Atk by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.beheeyem_crest.desc: Beheeyem disables an opponent's move when attacked. Faster opponents do reduced damage to Beheeyem.
item.rejuvcrests.torterra_crest.desc: Torterra's resistances and weaknesses are swapped, retaining immunities. Attacks restore HP.
item.rejuvcrests.infernape_crest.desc: Infernape's Attacking and Defensive stats are equalized. 1/16th Max HP is restored every turn.
item.rejuvcrests.empoleon_crest.desc: Empoleon's Ice-type moves are boosted by 50%, and Speed is doubled in Hail, Snow and on Ice Fields.
item.rejuvcrests.cryogonal_crest.desc: Increases Cryogonal's Sp. Def by 20%, then increases its other stats by 10% of its Sp. Def.
item.rejuvcrests.castform_crest.desc: Castform uses the first weather move it knows. Its Forecast forms also become empowered.
item.rejuvcrests.thievul_crest.desc: Decreases opponent's Sp. Atk by one stage, increasing Thievul's by one stage on switch.
item.rejuvcrests.probopass_crest.desc: Probopass levitates, and Mini-noses do 3-hit 20BP type-based damage after a damaging move.
item.rejuvcrests.druddigon_crest.desc: Heals in the sun and from Fire-type moves. Fire- and Dragon-type moves get boosted by 30%.
item.rejuvcrests.cinccino_crest.desc: All single target moves turn into multi-hit moves (2-5 hits at 40% the BP).
item.rejuvcrests.noctowl_crest.desc: Increases Special Defense upon being hit. Increases Defense by 30%.
item.rejuvcrests.luxray_crest.desc: Gains Dark-type STAB and resistances. Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves and deal 20% more damage.
item.rejuvcrests.boltund_crest.desc: Gain a 1.5x boost to biting moves if Boltund moves before target.
item.rejuvcrests.vespiquen_crest.desc: Attack Order and Defend Order grant a 50% boost to Offenses or Defenses, switching around when the other is used.
item.rejuvcrests.phione_crest.desc: Phione is granted a 50% increase in defenses and Aqua Ring.
item.rejuvcrests.delcatty_crest.desc: The power of its non-KO'd friends increases Delcatty's stats by 10% each.
item.rejuvcrests.swalot_crest.desc: Stockpiles gained after an attack. Belch always usable and followed by Spit Up.
item.rejuvcrests.samurott_crest.desc: Unovan Samurott gains Fighting-type STAB and resistances. Slicing moves always result in critical hit.
item.rejuvcrests.reuniclus_crest.desc: Move changes user to a Physical Fighting or Special Psychic. First move determines initial form. SpATK -> 1.25x.
item.rejuvcrests.electrode_crest.desc: The target's Defense stat is halved when Kantonian Electrode is attacking. Non-Attack and Speed stats are also boosted by 10% of Speed.
item.rejuvcrests.crabominable_crest.desc: Powers up moves by 50% if holder takes damage before using them. Defense and Sp. Def are also boosted by 25%.
item.rejuvcrests.simisear_crest.desc: Gains Water-type STAB and resistances. Normal-type moves become Water-type. Attack and Sp. Atk are boosted by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.simipour_crest.desc: Gains Grass-type STAB and resistances. Normal-type moves become Grass-type. Attack and Sp. Atk are boosted by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.simisage_crest.desc: Gains Fire-type STAB and resistances. Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Attack and Sp. Atk are boosted by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.sawsbuck_crest.desc: Replaces Normal-type with a Seasonal type. Normal-type moves become the Seasonal type and are boosted by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.shiinotic_crest.desc: Draining effects and Sp. Def boosted by 30%. Spotlight applied to Partner on entry.
item.rejuvcrests.luvdisc_crest.desc: The Base Power of all damaging moves matches Luvdisc's happiness, capping at a Base Power of 250.
item.rejuvcrests.zoroark_crest.desc: Grants the ability of the copied Pokémon to Zoroark. Additionally gives it STAB on that Pokémon's typing.
item.rejuvcrests.furret_crest.desc: Upon switching in, Furret loses 25% of its Max HP to create a substitute.
item.rejuvcrests.plusle_crest.desc: Activates Plus. Raises the power of physical moves of the user and its partner by 33%.
item.rejuvcrests.minun_crest.desc: Activates Minus. Weakens the power of physical moves targetting the user and its partner by 33%.
item.rejuvcrests.flygon_crest.desc: Boosts own-side Sound moves by 50%. Own side immune to each other's Sound moves. Sound moves scale off Attack.
item.rejuvcrests.sunflora_crest.desc: An item to be held by Sunflora. User behaves as if Sun is active and heals 10% HP every turn.
item.rejuvcrests.entei_crest.desc: Fire moves become spread moves, all moves scale in BP based on how much total HP Entei has.
item.rejuvcrests.suicune_crest.desc: Holder ignores the negative effects of status conditions and sets a 1 Turn Tailwind on entry.
item.rejuvcrests.raikou_crest.desc: Holder's and any possible partners' moves act as if Rain and Electric Terrain are present.
item.rejuvcrests.celebi_crest.desc: Holder makes time pass quicker, doubling the amount of turns that pass.
item.rejuvcrests.runerigus_crest.desc: Once per battle, curses opponent upon hit. Heals 1/16 HP per turn.
item.rejuvcrests.ninetales_crest.desc: Grants Ghost STAB and resistances. Disables opponent's move upon hit.
item.rejuvcrests.mightyena_crest.desc: Biting moves given 50% boost in power. Speed increased by 20%.
item.rejuvcrests.jolteon_crest.desc: Gains Water-type STAB. Normal-type moves become Water-type. Attack scales with Special Attack.
item.rejuvcrests.flareon_crest.desc: Gains Electric-type STAB. Normal-type moves become Electric-type. Speed boosted by 40%.
item.rejuvcrests.vaporeon_crest.desc: Gains Fire-type STAB. Normal-type moves become Fire-type. Heals 1/16th of its HP each turn.
